issues.claim: Spina Records, 118 Easton Avenue (record store, active storefront)
issues.problem: Contradicted by the business's own site: the New Brunswick brick-and-mortar ran 2014-2025 and Spina is now an online store run from the Princeton area (vinyl plus mobile carts). The row presents a closed storefront as an active zone business.
issues.fix: Remove from the zone list, or recategorise as online-only and drop it from outreach.

issues.claim: Stress Factory Comedy Club, 375 George Street

issues.fix: Correct address to 90 Church Street and add 732-545-4242, or drop the venue as a borderline (comedy club/bar) row.

issues.claim: UCEDA Institute of New Brunswick, 338 George Street, 2nd Floor (language school)
issues.problem: Excluded type: schools are on the exclusion list, and this is an ESL school. Address and phone are correct (338 George St, 732-214-9500) but the entry should not be in scope; it is also one site of a 13-location operator.

issues.claim: Excel Career Training Institute, 97 Bayard Street, Suite 201 (career/CNA training school)
issues.problem: Excluded type: schools. Phone also conflicts with the NJ Department of Health approved nurse-aide programme listing, which gives 732-828-8100 rather than 732-828-8787.

issues.claim: Motion Industries Inc., 22 Home News Row (industrial supplies)
issues.problem: Excluded type: branch of a national industrial distributor, i.e. a chain. The mapper's own note concedes this. The cited NJ business directory page does not actually carry the row, and the other cited URL is a manufacturer's distributor index, not a New Brunswick listing.
issues.fix: Remove the row (or demote to data_gaps as a flagged exclusion).

issues.claim: Coverage of group D in downtown New Brunswick
issues.problem: Own searches across 14 categories found only 8 of 13 eligible independent New Brunswick businesses already listed (about 62%, below the 70% bar). Repeated gaps: shoe repair, tattoo studios, lumber/building materials.
issues.fix: Add Brunswick Shoemaker, Revolver Tattoo, Anchor Tattoo, Green Building/Lattanzio Lumber and (weaker) Art & Tattoo Emporium before the zone is worked.

issues.problem: Wrong website field: the verified site is bnathanielbespoke.com (contact page shows 28 Paterson St and 732-735-1480). bnatbespoke.com opens a different Squarespace site with 'EST. 1976' branding and no New Brunswick address.
The cited profile URL returns only generic 'Dollar Store business description' boilerplate with no address or phone, so the single-source claim is not actually evidenced on the page cited.
issues.fix: Re-cite the City Center shopping index (where the address and number appear) or confirm at the storefront.

issues.claim: Optical Boutique, One Spring Street Unit 101 / 732-246-6895
issues.problem: Cited City Center profile carries marketing copy only - no address, phone or hours - so the source does not support the address. The business does check out on its own site (myopticalboutique.com) with that address and number.
issues.fix: Keep the row but add website https://www.myopticalboutique.com and cite it.

issues.claim: Redwood Florist, 151 Albany Street, no website

issues.fix: Add https://www.redwoodflorist.com and record the location as 'inside New Brunswick Train Station'.

issues.claim: Alfa Art Gallery, 108 Church Street, phone Unknown
issues.problem: Phone is recorded as Unknown although the City Center profile for the gallery publishes 732-296-6720. The cited source is the generic directory index, not the gallery's profile page.
issues.fix: Fill in 732-296-6720 and cite the profile URL.

issues.problem: Own location page confirms only 'George Street, downtown New Brunswick' - no street number, no phone. Street number and number come from the City Center listing only.
issues.fix: Keep, but mark street number and phone as directory-sourced and confirm at outreach.

issues.claim: Kim's Bike Shop, 111 French Street, no website
issues.problem: Business confirmed (111 French St, 732-846-3880) but its own site kimsbikes.com exists and is omitted.

LMTD Supply and Lady LMTD share one phone number and one City Center profile page; Hub City Smokes and Hub City Soles share 84 Paterson Street. Both pairs are disclosed in notes but still occupy two rows each.
issues.fix: Merge into single operator rows or mark clearly as one operator, two storefronts.

issues.problem: Second Reformed Thrift Shop (8 Stone St, confirmed), Mt. Zion CDC Preschool, Gan Yeladeem and the two Catholic Charities centres are congregation-affiliated. The mapper applied a uniform scope rule and documented it, so this is defensible rather than an error, but it is the list's largest judgement call.
issues.fix: No change needed if the rule is accepted by the team; otherwise drop the faith-affiliated rows.
